fields.name: title
fields.label: Service Name
fields.description: How the service appears in menus and listings (e.g. "Spray-In Bedliner").

fields.name: slug
fields.label: URL Slug
fields.description: Used in the URL: /services/<slug>.html. Lowercase, dashes only.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: Group used for filtering — e.g. "bedliners", "protection", "truck-accessories".

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Short Summary
fields.description: One-sentence description shown in service cards on the homepage and listings.

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Lucide icon name (e.g. "truck", "shield", "sparkles"). See lucide.dev for options.

fields.name: priceFrom
fields.label: Starting Price ($)
fields.description: Minimum price shown as "From $X". Leave blank for "Custom Quote".

fields.name: sortOrder
fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Lower numbers appear first on listings. 1 = top.

fields.name: active
fields.label: Visible on Site
fields.description: Uncheck to temporarily hide this service from menus and listings.

fields.name: hero
fields.label: Hero Section (Top of Page)
fields.description: The large banner at the top of this service page.

fields.name: badge
fields.label: Hero Badge
fields.description: Small label shown above the headline (e.g. "Authorized Patriot Liner Dealer"). Optional.

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Hero Headline
fields.description: The big H1 at the top of the page. Keep it punchy — under ~10 words.

fields.name: subheadline
fields.label: Hero Subheadline
fields.description: One or two sentences directly under the headline.

fields.name: primaryCtaLabel
fields.label: Primary Button Label
fields.description: Text on the orange button (e.g. "Get a Free Quote").

fields.name: primaryCtaUrl
fields.label: Primary Button Link
fields.description: Where the orange button goes. Use /quote.html for the standard quote form.

fields.name: secondaryCtaLabel
fields.label: Secondary Button Label
fields.description: Text on the outlined button. Often a phone number — "Call (301) 304-1419".

fields.name: secondaryCtaUrl
fields.label: Secondary Button Link
fields.description: For phone, use tel:3013041419. For another page, use a path like /contact.html.

fields.name: pricing
fields.label: Pricing Table
fields.description: Rows shown in the service's pricing table. Add as many as you need; leave empty to hide the table.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Tier / Size
fields.description: E.g. "Compact (up to 5ft)" or "Standard Package".

fields.name: price
fields.label: Price
fields.description: Display string — e.g. "$575" or "From $1,200".

fields.name: note
fields.label: Note
fields.description: Optional small text under the price (e.g. "+ tax", "popular pick").

fields.name: kpis
fields.label: Benefits / KPI Strip
fields.description: Small tiles of stats or selling points displayed in a horizontal strip.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: Big number/text shown front-and-center — e.g. "30+", "5.0★".

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Description under the value — e.g. "Years Serving DMV".

fields.name: process
fields.label: Process / Steps
fields.description: "How it works" — describe the steps a customer goes through.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Step Title
fields.description: Short heading for the step (e.g. "Inspect").

fields.name: description
fields.label: Step Description
fields.description: 1–2 sentence explanation of what happens at this step.

fields.name: faqs
fields.label: FAQs (Page-Specific)
fields.description: Questions specific to this service. The site combines these with global FAQs.

fields.name: question
fields.label: Question
fields.description: The question as the visitor would ask it.

fields.name: answer
fields.label: Answer
fields.description: A clear, friendly answer in 1–3 sentences.

fields.name: seoTitle
fields.label: SEO — Page Title
fields.description: Shown in browser tab and Google results. ~60 chars max.

fields.name: seoDescription
fields.label: SEO — Meta Description
fields.description: Search-engine snippet. ~155 chars max.

aiAssist.promptHint: e.g. "add city names", "include phone number", "under 155 chars"
